column4: Wide scene, locked camera. The tall stained-glass window with the icon of the girl (as in the first reference) stands on the left-center of the frame in a dark cathedral wall. A thick lock of her long orange hair has slipped out through the right edge of the leaded frame and hangs straight down in the open air to the right of the window. A white-gloved hand with the ruffled cuff and orange sleeve (as in the second reference) enters from the upper right holding a large pair of scissors with ivory blades, coal-black outline and orange handles. The blades are wide OPEN, the hanging lock lying between them, about to bite. Five clear fingers, hand calm and precise, no text.

Close-up from the side: only the doll's forearm and clenched fist, raised at the left-center of the frame, seen in profile. The porcelain fist is tightly closed, knuckles ridged, thumb wrapped over the fingers, a ball joint at the wrist with a wrist ring and a ruffled white cuff and black sleeve running off the left edge. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the subject has a clean closed outline against it. No strings, no floor, no shadow. Orange hair strands fall at the top right corner. No text.

Same camera and scale as the reference curtsey. She makes a deep, graceful, voluntary theatrical bow: torso bent forward about ninety degrees, one arm sweeping across her front, the other arm trailing out behind, head down so her long orange hair swings forward, one leg extended behind. Three-quarter side view. Full-body view. Same porcelain maid doll as in the reference sheet and approved poses: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, black dress with white apron and ruffles, ball joints and wrist rings. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the subject has a clean closed outline against it. No strings, no floor, no shadow. The whole figure fits the frame with a small margin.
